enrichment_method: BioID samples were simultaneously labeled using 250 μM biotin and treated with 10 nM T3 or vehicle for 15 min.
fractionation_method: The eluents were loaded onto 10% Tris–glycine gels (Invitrogen XP00100BOX), and separated by SDS-PAGE.
instrument: LC–MS was performed using an LTQ-Orbitrap instrument (ThermoFisher).
